_comment: Mock mode stand-in for 'the agent reasons from its own knowledge, without searching'. In live mode this step is a real LLM call asking the model to propose a likely parent from its own training knowledge, which is then checked against the catalog. Keyed by vendor_id since mock mode has no live model to ask.

V003.rationale: "Advisory GmbH" is a common naming pattern for a European advisory arm of a larger group; the base name closely matches a known catalog entity.
